title: LedgerAccount (chart of accounts)
description: One line of the chart of accounts: `accounts(code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name, type, statement)` in db/schema/pg-schema.sql. NOT the same thing as a treasury Account (internal capital) or an ExchangeAccount (a venue link) - three nouns, one word, which is why the contract names this one LedgerAccount. Rows are the debit_account / credit_account / account_code targets of journal and ledger. The table has NO WRITER in the repo today (grep for INSERT into accounts finds none), so this is the read-model shape, not a live entity.

code.description: Primary key; the code referenced by journal.debit_account / journal.credit_account / ledger.account_code.

type.description: Free-text account class in the schema (unconstrained TEXT); the value set lives in code, so it is typed as a string here rather than invented as a closed enum.

statement.description: Which statement the account appears on (schema column `statement`).
